problem_statement: src/cli.ts (1075 lines, 2nd-highest churn file in the repo) mixes CLI bootstrap/arg-parsing with a client-config installer that reads/writes third-party MCP client JSON config files under locking and atomic-write guarantees. The two concerns change for unrelated reasons but share one file and one git history.
chosen_pattern: None applied yet — boundary recorded, no physical split performed (single-caller deletion test was mixed; value is locality/churn-separation, not reuse).

dependencies: src/cli.js (CliExitError, IS_WINDOWS, validateCliPath — latter two newly exported)

constraints: Preserve acquireLock's stale-lock takeover (30s) and retry/backoff behavior exactly
Preserve writeJsonAtomic's temp-file+rename with non-atomic direct-write fallback on rename failure
Keep ModifyOptions (client, config, serverName, dryRun) as the stable external CLI flag surface
runPrintConfig/EffectiveConfig/PrintConfigOptions stay with CLI bootstrap, not client-config, despite current section-comment placement
acquireLock and writeJsonAtomic remain internal to client-config — no shared utils location

risk_register.risk: A future split accidentally moves runPrintConfig into client-config because it currently sits inside the same section comment
risk_register.mitigation: ADR-0001 explicitly calls out runPrintConfig as CLI bootstrap, not installer, independent of its current location in the file

risk_register.risk: Splitting breaks __tests__/unit/config-helper.test.ts's direct import of writeJsonAtomic from src/cli.js
risk_register.mitigation: Any future split must update that test's import path in the same change, not as a follow-up

risk_register.risk: Re-implementing acquireLock/writeJsonAtomic introduces a regression in the stale-lock or atomic-write fallback path, corrupting a user's real client config file
risk_register.mitigation: Treat both functions as preserve-verbatim during any move; do not rewrite alongside the relocation

next_steps: No file split performed in this pass — boundary recorded only, per explicit user direction
When cli.ts is next touched for either bootstrap or installer work, consult ADR-0001 before adding new exports to either side

If/when physically splitting: move the client-config export list above verbatim into a new file, keep writeJsonAtomic exported for the existing test import, leave runPrintConfig/EffectiveConfig/PrintConfigOptions in cli.ts
